cases.prompt: The HTTP handoff report endpoint supports JSON and Markdown, but get_handoff_report through MCP fails for Markdown. Repair the MCP transport so both formats remain usable, preserving the HTTP response contract. Add an appropriate regression test.

Registered custom Sources accept Unicode and spaces in their Source IDs, but reading a published Profile or its revision can fail after using those IDs. Preserve accepted Source identities throughout the public artifact API, including list and revision reads. Keep the canonical OpenAPI and generated Python contract consistent.

A viewer can read two Scopes. Reusing a Memory citation from the populated Scope against the empty Scope incorrectly returns owner-pending instead of a missing Memory response. Distinguish missing Memory from genuinely pending artifact ownership, while preserving identical forbidden responses for unauthorized callers and retaining genuine owner-pending behavior.

A Profile generated from a registered custom Source and normal content loses or rejects the custom Source provenance in artifact reads. Preserve the registered Source name and ID through candidate approval, artifact read and artifact listing, with a compatible public contract.

SQLite vector rows accumulate after Memory entries are updated or deleted. Fix Memory commit handling and the SQLite vector index so obsolete entry-version rows are removed. Retained entries must remain searchable and other Scopes must remain intact.

Skill ZIP validation can accept hostile raw entry names when the host ZIP implementation normalizes a backslash or truncates at a NUL byte. Reject these raw names before normalization hides them. Keep valid package capture and deterministic package hashes working across platforms.

Artifact conditional GET only recognizes one exact If-None-Match value. Support weak validators, comma-separated validators and the wildcard, preserving current 304 behavior and returning content for genuinely nonmatching values.

Appending execution instructions to a factual recall question suppresses short relevant memories and admits instruction-only overlap. Separate query evidence from execution instructions without weakening long domain-query admission. Explicit policy questions and quoted identifiers, including AND and OR, must retain their literal meaning. Preserve direct recall and prepared-context behavior.

The local Server CLI starts without reading the current directory .env unless --env-file is explicitly passed. Default CLI startup must discover a local .env, while an explicit --env-file remains supported. Keep direct programmatic ServerSettings() environment-only. Process environment takes priority over file values, including nested settings. Preserve literal file values containing dollar expressions or apostrophes and preserve provider environment-key case. Restore temporary environment changes after the startup configuration context exits. Add a regression test.

The shell-free dotenv parser cannot read multiline quoted values. Make it preserve complete multiline JSON values inside single or double quotes, including escaped JSON quotes, embedded hash characters, dollar signs, backticks, indentation and newline boundaries. Continue parsing following assignments, reject an unterminated quote, and keep existing valid single-line behavior. Large multiline input must parse in linear time without executing any content as shell code. Add regression tests.
